reads_only: committed artifacts; no arm, floor or margin is read on any label

scopes.debuted: matrix rows kind == 'debuted' with a censored target and a consensus FV (tools/efv_driver_lab.load_pool)
scopes.readable: the debuted pool restricted to rows with at least one MiLB season readable at the decision point (tools/efv_volume_driver_lab.build_pool readable_only)
scopes.full_observable: every matrix row (debuted and bust) restricted to the IL-observable cohort (tools/efv_health_profile_lab.build_pool full_pool + observable_mask)
scopes.debuted_observable: the debuted pool restricted to the IL-observable cohort (tools/efv_health_profile_lab.build_pool + observable_mask)

H-MECH.legs_rule: both legs of every arm (rho and contributor AUC) count in m; the fv liveness controls are run first and sit outside m

P-MECH.legs_rule: both legs of every arm (rho and contributor AUC) count in m; the fv liveness controls are run first and sit outside m

H-NOMECH.legs_rule: both legs of every arm (rho and contributor AUC) count in m; the fv liveness controls are run first and sit outside m

rules.dedupe: one arm per (side, frame, scope, column definition, dropped columns); a column read in several lanes carries every origin
rules.frame: 4-fold-era arms run on the 11-fold basis (the retired 4-fold basis is not reproduced, plan 2.4); D-2 on the six-fold frame; the 09-04 families on their original scopes
rules.mechanism: plan 2.2: a hitter column tagged fielding or position goes to H-MECH; a pitcher column tagged k/bb/hr skill, runs allowed to FIP or starter/reliever shape goes to P-MECH; the 09-04 families go to the no-mechanism families by O8
rules.posture: where an artifact read one column under two imputation postures (xfv_weight_recal_eval.json mean and zero), the arm carries the shipped-convention zero posture that every other lane reading the same column used; the train-fold mean posture is fold-dependent and is not a column
rules.exclusions: R-SERVED (carries a served feature: ABL reads it), R-SWAP (a replacement, not an add), R-27 (plan 2.7 NO), R-DEGENERATE (outside its original Holm family: constant on its scope or degenerate)
